questions.q: What is the capital of Taiwan?
questions.why: Taipei 101 stands there.

questions.q: Which party fled to Taiwan after losing China's civil war in 1949?
questions.why: It was led by Chiang Kai-shek.

questions.q: Who led the government that moved to Taiwan in 1949?
questions.why: He ruled until 1975.

questions.q: Which country ruled Taiwan from 1895 to 1945?
questions.why: It took Taiwan after the First Sino-Japanese War.

questions.q: What is Taiwan's currency?
questions.why: Its code is TWD.

questions.q: What is the official name of Taiwan's government?
questions.why: It was founded in 1912 on the mainland.

questions.q: What did Portuguese sailors call Taiwan?
questions.why: It means 'beautiful island'.

questions.q: Which company in Taiwan makes most of the world's advanced chips?
questions.why: It was founded by Morris Chang in 1987.

questions.q: Who became Taiwan's first woman President, in 2016?
questions.why: She served two terms.

questions.q: Who became President of Taiwan in 2024?
questions.why: He is from the DPP.

questions.q: Which 1947 crackdown is remembered on 28 February?
questions.why: Thousands were killed.

questions.q: Which Dutch fort in Tainan dates from the 1600s?
questions.why: The Dutch ruled southern Taiwan from 1624.

questions.q: Which Ming loyalist drove the Dutch out of Taiwan in 1662?
questions.why: He is a folk hero in Taiwan.

questions.q: Which 2014 student protest occupied Taiwan's parliament?
questions.why: It opposed a trade pact with China.

questions.q: Who was Taiwan's first directly elected President, in 1996?
questions.why: He was called 'Mr Democracy'.

questions.q: In which year did Taiwan lift martial law?
questions.why: It had lasted 38 years.

questions.q: Which Taipei skyscraper was the world's tallest from 2004 to 2010?
questions.why: It has a huge damper ball.

questions.q: Which tea drink with tapioca pearls was invented in Taiwan?
questions.why: It began in the 1980s.

questions.q: Which Taipei museum holds treasures from China's imperial collection?
questions.why: The Jadeite Cabbage is a favourite.

questions.q: Which famous evening markets sell street food all over Taiwan?
questions.why: Shilin is Taipei's best known.

questions.q: Which smelly fermented snack is sold at night markets?
questions.why: You can smell it from afar.

questions.q: Which lake in central Taiwan is its largest?
questions.why: Its two parts look like a sun and a moon.

questions.q: Which gorge on the east coast is a national park?
questions.why: It has marble cliffs.

questions.q: Which Taiwanese director won Oscars for 'Brokeback Mountain' and 'Life of Pi'?
questions.why: He won Best Director twice.

questions.q: Which soup with beef and noodles is a Taiwanese favourite?
questions.why: Taipei holds a festival for it.

questions.q: Which festival releases glowing paper lanterns at Pingxi?
questions.why: It is on the 15th day of the New Year.

questions.q: Which restaurant chain from Taipei is famous for soup dumplings?
questions.why: Its xiaolongbao have 18 folds.

questions.q: Which mountain is Taiwan's highest?
questions.why: It is about 3,950 m high.

questions.q: Which Taiwanese singer is called the 'King of Mandopop'?
questions.why: He blends R&B and Chinese styles.

questions.q: Which forest railway climbs through sacred tree groves?
questions.why: It was built during Japanese rule.

questions.q: Which sport did Taiwan's national team win the 2024 Premier12 in?
questions.why: It beat Japan in the final.
